hypothesis: Under equal-example fixed-budget training, family-balanced three-source full-batch training increases worst-source holdout accuracy over affine-only full-batch training across three fresh development cohorts without material degradation in overall or individual-source accuracy.
design: Prospective frozen-seed out-of-cohort replication of published W-R52 algorithm; not a claim of new model architecture or real-world transfer.

decision_rule.unit: Each of three development blocks separately, using identity encoding and aggregate 48 heldout seeds; xor55 must exactly match identity for each of six models.
decision_rule.source_accuracy: For each block and source family, total per-seed source credited correct / (48*36); minimum across the three source families is worst-source accuracy.
decision_rule.gain: Worst source-family accuracy for three_source_balanced_full_batch minus worst source-family accuracy for affine_only_full_batch, within each development block. No averaging across blocks.
decision_rule.source_harm: For each source, three_source_balanced_full_batch source-family accuracy minus affine_only_full_batch source-family accuracy for same development block.
decision_rule.strict_block: gain >= worst_source_gain_min AND mixed model overall heldout accuracy >= mixed_overall_accuracy_min AND every source_harm >= -max_source_harm.
decision_rule.partial_block: gain >= partial_gain_min. Does not require a strict block.
precedence: FAMILY_DIVERSITY_ROBUST iff all three blocks strict
else PARTIAL_FAMILY_GAIN iff at least partial_cohorts_min blocks partial
decision_rule.validity: Fail INVALID on missing/corrupted provenance, cohort, capacity, budget, or raw measurements; INDETERMINATE on interrupted first-use regardless of outcome; no post-result tuning.
